prompt_used: Rebuild the website for Demmel & Partner Baumanagement AG, a construction management (Baumanagement) firm based in Zürich, Switzerland, founded 2019. The team brings over 25 years of combined industry experience. Core services: overall project management and organization of construction projects (Gesamtleitung und Organisation von Bauvorhaben), project planning and execution, and quality assurance on construction sites (Qualitätssicherung am Bau). The site should cover: Home (mission: supporting clients across all aspects of construction management), Services (Dienstleistungen), Team (Unser Team — experienced staff covering all planning and construction-process disciplines), Reference Projects (Referenzobjekte — trust, competence, and enjoyable collaboration as the foundation), News, Jobs (currently hiring a Chefbauleiter/site manager, open to speculative applications), and Contact. Write all site copy in German (Swiss business audience). Professional, trustworthy tone — construction/engineering sector, not consumer-facing.
